description:
Key an issue's required gates and gate states by `GateKey`, and parse gate-key arguments once at the boundary.

## Background

`Issue.gates_required` is a `Vec<String>` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:429`) and `Issue.gates_status` a `HashMap<String, GateState>` (`:431`). Gate keys travel as strings through `commands/gate.rs`, `commands/gate_check.rs`, `commands/template.rs`, `commands/issue.rs`, `templates.rs`, `output.rs`, `main.rs`, `cli.rs` and `crates/server/src/routes.rs` (288 production references in 31 files).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Issue.gates_required` is a `Vec<GateKey>` and `Issue.gates_status` is keyed by `GateKey`.
- [hard] REQ-02: CLI and server gate-key arguments are parsed once into `GateKey` at the boundary.
- [hard] REQ-03: No command, template or output code holds a gate key as `String` or `&str`.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every issue record in this repository decodes and re-serializes to the same canonical JSON, and re-serializing the serializer's output is byte-identical.
title: Issue gate fields are keyed by GateKey
